why: The India Gate hexagon is one ring of even width on Esri World Imagery (west side about 22 m of asphalt from Kartavya Path to Ashoka Road); OSM tags 5 lanes on most of the ring, this piece had 4 (taken from the road ahead): the ring keeps one cross section (P1-046)

reference.note: Esri World Imagery of the hexagon west side at Kartavya Path, about 0.28 m per pixel
